components.basis: Both sheets present every source rule (S: D1,D2,D3,B,A,T,I,X; S-dagger: D,B,A,T,I,X,N), invoked on route by \showcalculus at main-text lines 114-115. Written proofs supply: rule soundness and derivation induction; Lemma 3.1 both directions with all rule cases (D; B in three polarity cases; A/T/I; X/N) and D1 redundancy; Lemma 3.2 parts 1-3; Lemmas 3.3, 3.4 and the union remark; Lemma 3.5 with the nonempty-start case; Theorem 3.6 via compactness reduction, Case (1) all four ordered choices, Case (2) including u = l-bar and both m sub-cases, Case (3) via N, and the inconsistent-premise case via a minimal unsatisfiable subset and X; Theorem 3.7 reduction from S-dagger to S (exclusion of forall(p-bar,q) by the all-empty singleton structure, propagation of exists(p-bar,q-bar) through I and D, X excluded for satisfiable premises, rule-instance replacement) and its inconsistent-premise case. Failure condition not met: first-order logic is used only for compactness (as in the source) and the translation lemma; the completeness argument is the direct syllogistic one.
